query.name: cleanup-project-build-step
query.comment: Cleanup the build steps of a project.
query.sql: DELETE FROM porion_build_step WHERE build_id IN (SELECT id FROM porion_build WHERE project_id = :project_id)

query.name: cleanup-project-build-metrics
query.sql: DELETE FROM porion_build_metric WHERE build_id IN (SELECT porion_build.id FROM porion_build WHERE porion_build.project_id = :project_id)

query.name: cleanup-project-build-queue
query.comment: Remove the project from build queue.
query.sql: DELETE FROM porion_build_queue WHERE recipe_id IN (SELECT porion_recipe.id FROM porion_recipe WHERE porion_recipe.project_id = :project_id)

query.name: cleanup-project-test-run
query.comment: Cleanup the test run of a project.
query.sql: DELETE FROM porion_test_run WHERE group_id IN (SELECT porion_test_run_group.id FROM porion_test_run_group INNER JOIN porion_test_group ON porion_test_run_group.group_id = porion_test_group.id WHERE porion_test_group.project_id = :project_id)

query.name: cleanup-project-test-run-group
query.comment: Cleanup the test run group of a project.
query.sql: DELETE FROM porion_test_run_group WHERE group_id IN (SELECT id FROM porion_test_group WHERE porion_test_group.project_id = :project_id)

query.name: cleanup-project-test
query.comment: Cleanup the test of a project.
query.sql: DELETE FROM porion_test WHERE group_id IN (SELECT id FROM porion_test_group WHERE porion_test_group.project_id = :project_id)

query.name: cleanup-project-test-group
query.comment: Cleanup the test group of a project.

query.name: cleanup-project-last-build
query.comment: Cleanup the project last build references of a project.
query.sql: DELETE FROM porion_last_build WHERE recipe_id IN (SELECT id FROM porion_recipe WHERE project_id = :project_id)

query.name: cleanup-project-environment
query.sql: DELETE FROM porion_environment WHERE recipe_id IN (SELECT id FROM porion_recipe WHERE project_id = :project_id)

query.name: cleanup-project-build-config-step
query.comment: Cleanup the project build config of a project.
query.sql: DELETE FROM porion_recipe_step WHERE recipe_id IN (SELECT id FROM porion_recipe WHERE project_id = :project_id)

query.name: cleanup-project-build-config
query.comment: Cleanup the project build recipe of a project.

query.name: cleanup-project-branch
query.comment: Cleanup the project branch of a project.

query.name: cleanup-project-dependency
query.comment: Cleanup the project dependencies of a project.
query.sql: DELETE FROM porion_dependency WHERE project_id = :project_id OR owner_id = :project_id
